title: Input-head position bound
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic multi-tape Turing machine, let $x$ be a fixed input word, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$ with input-head position $p$. For every $t\in\mathbb{N}$, the input-head position after running $M$ from $c$ for $t$ steps is at most $p+t$.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration on a fixed input word
replaced:
Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine on an input word $x$, whose input-head
position ranges over $\{0, 1, \dots, |x| + 1\}$, and let $c$ be a
configuration of $M$ with input-head position $p$.  Then for every
$t \in \mathbb{N}$, the input-head position in the configuration reached by
running $M$ for $t$ steps from $c$ is at most $p + t$.
